stories.title: Democrats win both chambers, setting up divided US government
stories.summary: AP, NPR and Reuters reported Democratic victories in both congressional chambers. The incoming majority promised affordability measures and oversight, while Trump's continuing veto power limited the prospect of rapid legislation.
stories.whyItMatters: The result changes the balance over spending, appointments and scrutiny of the administration from January.
stories.selectionRationale: A consequential change in national power with international policy implications.
stories.evidenceNote: AP and Reuters report the outcome; NPR supplies its own congressional analysis but explicitly uses AP race calls. Independent newsrooms do not mean independent election tallies. No final seat count or certified result is asserted.

stories.title: EU sees a possible Montenegro accession treaty in 2027 as candidate paths diverge
stories.summary: The European Commission said Montenegro could finish accession talks in 2026 and sign a treaty in June 2027. Its annual assessment also offered Serbia a conditional opening and highlighted deterioration in relations with Georgia.
stories.whyItMatters: Enlargement could reshape European institutions, economic integration and regional influence.
stories.selectionRationale: A formal annual assessment with concrete, conditional milestones for several candidate countries.
stories.evidenceNote: Reuters, AP and Euronews independently report the same enlargement package from different country perspectives. Commission forecasts remain conditional; publication of an assessment is not admission to the EU.

stories.title: Bangladesh sets a garment-pay timetable as protests continue
stories.summary: The wage board announced a revised structure effective from December, with first payments in January. The amount remained unsettled as workers' protests and factory closures continued.
stories.whyItMatters: The dispute affects millions of workers and production for international clothing supply chains.
stories.selectionRationale: A concrete new wage-board timetable, distinct from its earlier creation, amid continuing disruption.
stories.evidenceNote: Reuters interviews, AP's protest report and the Daily Star's board coverage are independently authored. Board statements establish the announced timetable, not delivery of a pay rise.
